a.lede: The idea of embedded evaluators — in which supposedly "neutral" third-party observers are placed inside AI organizations — has been popularized over the last several months, as AI labs grapple with a rash of safety incidents that have spurred concerns over the potential harms of their technology.
a.title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says

b.lede: As AI labs continue to self-regulate, external evaluators play a crucial role in spotting risks.
b.title: Anthropic gives third-party auditors ’employee-like access’ in AI industry first
